messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
allah ya kawo mana shugabbani nagari idan da akwai adalci a milkinka ai babu wanda zai sace kayan abinciallah ya iya mama

output.original_text: allah ya kawo mana shugabbani nagari idan da akwai adalci a milkinka ai babu wanda zai sace kayan abinci allah ya iya mama
output.joy: Allah, ka kawo mana shugabbani nagari! Tabbas, tare da adalci a milkinka, za mu iya tabbatar da cewa babu wanda zai sace kayan abinci! Allah ya taimake mu!
output.sadness: Allah, ina rokonka ka kawo mana shugabbani nagari; da alama adalci a milkinka ba ya wanzu, saboda haka har yanzu akwai wadanda suke sace kayan abinci. Allah, ka jiƙa mu.
output.fear: Allah, na yi addu'a ka kawo mana shugabbani nagari, domin ina jin tsoro idan adalci a milkinka ba ya wanzu. Wace irin zagon kasa ne zai iya sace kayan abinci?
output.anger: Allah, wane lokaci ne za ka kawo mana shugabbani nagari? Idan adalci a milkinka na gaskiya, to, ya kamata a daina sace kayan abinci! Allah, ka yi mana adalci!
output.surprise: Allah, ka kawo mana shugabbani nagari? Ina jin mamaki ko adalci a milkinka na hakika, idan har ba a sace kayan abinci ba! Allah, ka yi mana tsari!
output.disgust: Allah, ina fushi da wannan halin! Yaya za a yi a kawo mana shugabbani nagari? Idan akwai adalci a milkinka, to me yasa har yanzu wasu suke sace kayan abinci? Allah, ka tsare mu!
